scope: Leopoldina DOB source-zone manual follow-up, rounds 1 through 4
stop_rule: No further open-ended person-by-person source searching. Additional discovery requires a separately preregistered, uniform protocol applied to the whole eligible unresolved cohort.
unresolved_interpretation: Unresolved means evidence threshold not met under the frozen protocol; it does not mean the candidate date is false.
analysis_rule: Primary analyses may use accepted exact DOBs. Missingness and coverage must be reported by relevant cohort variables; unresolved records remain excluded from exact-DOB analyses unless a later preregistered supplement is applied.
